t: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, heard a man recite : "Verily we are Allah's and verily to Him shall we return," (Qur'an, 2:156). Then he said : Our saying (inna li'llah) [Verily we are Allah's] is an admission of His Majesty over us and our saying (Wa inna ilayhi rajiun) [and verily to Him shall we return] is an admission of our being mortal
